newsitem.title: USA: TU 1,150 MW Tx. plant resumes full output.
newsitem.headline: TU 1,150 MW Tx. plant resumes full output.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co's 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear power unit 2 was operating at full output today after reducing power for a repair, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday.
The unit, in Glen Rose, Texas, was operating at 100 percent of capacity as of early Thursday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Power was reduced to near 52 percent of capacity Wednesday to correct an electrical problem.
The adjacent 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear unit 1 also was operating at full power, the NRC said in the report.
